 Best Concerts & Music Festivals in the US: May 2027
 November 5, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 May 2027 delivers one of the densest recent U.S. concert calendars, with Niall Horan’s nine-date arena sweep, Metallica’s M72 stadium run, Iron Maiden’s farewell shows, and Queens of the Stone Age + Pixies’ 16-date tour all confirmed as of November 2026.
 Texas and the Mountain West stand out as the month’s busiest corridors, with multiple arena and festival dates that make regional travel efficient for fans.
 Club and theater shows such as Two Door Cinema Club’s Tourist History Tour and Choir! Choir! Choir!’s limited Pacific Northwest dates will sell out fastest and should come before arena tickets on any purchase list.
 Festival weekends cluster around May 6–9 and May 13–16, so fans can anchor trips around Welcome to Rockville, Sonic Temple, Boardwalk Rock, or Kilby Block Party and fill surrounding days with arena or club shows.
 OnesToWatch Live is the best guide to May 2027 concerts in America because it pairs every major stadium and arena date with the club or theater show happening the same month that fans should see first, all confirmed as of November 2026.
 See Niall Horan At Toyota Center In Houston 
 Niall Horan — Dinner Party Live On Tour: May 2027 U.S. Dates
 Niall Horan's Dinner Party Live On Tour functions as the OnesToWatch Live anchor for May 2027. The Live Nation-produced run, which began on 22 September 2026 in Birmingham, England, opens its Texas dates on May 1, 2027, at the Toyota Center in Houston. It then moves through the Mountain West and West Coast before finishing in Vancouver on May 29. The following are the U.S. dates listed in the available data.

 Horan has sold over 90 million records worldwide across his career, including his time with One Direction and as a solo artist. His 2024 global headline trek, THE SHOW Live On Tour, was promoted as selling over 1.2 million tickets worldwide, though box-office tracking sources such as Touring Data and Pollstar reported roughly 1.04–1.06 million tickets sold . Dinner Party Live On Tour concludes its North American leg at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, BC on May 29, 2027, which sits just beyond the U.S. dates listed above.
 The Big Rooms and the Small Rooms
 Horan anchors the month’s arena calendar, yet many other acts also fill large rooms while smaller shows quietly sell out. May breaks into two tiers: the stadiums and arenas that stay available longer, and the clubs and theaters that close first.
 The Stadiums and Arenas
 Niall Horan — Dinner Party Live On Tour (Texas / Mountain West / West Coast, May 1–27) . Horan provides the month’s most consistent arena sweep. Nine U.S. arena dates run from Houston to Seattle, and all are on sale now. See the full date block above.
 Metallica — M72 Tour (stadiums, May 13–29) . Metallica brings the M72 World Tour back for five U.S. stadium dates in May, starting May 13 at Snapdragon Stadium in San Diego and ending May 29 at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City. Intermediate stops include El Paso, San Antonio, and Fayetteville. The M72 World Tour first launched on April 27, 2023, in Amsterdam . The Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere in Las Vegas, running October 1, 2026 to March 13, 2027, follows the tour . Tickets are available via Ticketmaster and StubHub.
 Queens of the Stone Age + Pixies — Perfecth World Tour (arenas, May 1–24) . Queens of the Stone Age and Pixies run a 16-date U.S. tour in May 2027, mostly at arenas with two outdoor exceptions. The run supports QOTSA’s ninth studio album Perfecth . Pixies and Wheelchair Sports Camp appear on every date of the Spring 2027 U.S. tour, which runs from May 1 in San Diego to May 24 in Boston . Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, CO hosts the tour on May 12, and American Family Insurance Amphitheater in Milwaukee hosts on May 15. General sale opened October 29, 2026.
 Calvin Harris — North American Arena Tour (arenas, May 5–27) . Calvin Harris's spring 2027 run is his first full headline arena tour of North America . He last toured the continent under his own name with club and theatre dates in 2010. The tour was announced on October 13, 2026 as an 18-date run across the U.S. and Canada and has since grown to 34 nights. U.S. May dates include May 5 at Delta Center in Salt Lake City, May 7 at Oakland Arena, May 14 at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, May 21 at Viejas Arena in San Diego, and May 27 at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, CA, closing his first headlining North American arena tour . No support acts are named, and new arena production is promised. Harris previously set a Guinness World Record for largest DJ set attendance with an estimated 1.6 million people at a free Carnival set in São Paulo.
 Iron Maiden — Run For Your Lives World Tour (arenas and festivals, May 1–16) . The 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees added a surprise 16-date North American leg after signaling a touring pause. U.S. May dates include Tampa on May 1, West Palm Beach on May 2, Atlanta on May 5, Raleigh on May 7, Hartford on May 9, and UBS Arena in Belmont Park, NY on May 11. The band then headlines Sonic Temple in Columbus on May 14 and closes Boardwalk Rock in Ocean City, MD on May 16, which is the final show of the entire Run For Your Lives tour. Bullet For My Valentine and The Raven Age support all headlining dates. General public on-sale was October 23, 2026.
 Riley Green — That’s Just Me Tour (arenas and amphitheaters, May 1–22) . Multi-platinum, ACM and CMA Award-winning country artist Riley Green plays seven U.S. dates in May. Stops include May 1 at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, SC; May 6 at Dickies Arena in Fort Worth; May 7 at INTRUST Bank Arena in Wichita; May 8 at Walmart AMP in Rogers, AR; May 20 at BOK Center in Tulsa; May 21 at Dos Equis Pavilion in Dallas; and May 22 at CAJUNDOME in Lafayette, LA. Special guests include Muscadine Bloodline, Randy Houser, Jake Worthington, and Hannah McFarland on select dates.
 John Mayer — Live at Sphere (Las Vegas, May 1–15) . Mayer plays seven May performances at Sphere in Las Vegas on May 1, 5, 7, 8, 12, 14, and 15. Each show runs three formats in one night, with a solo set, a full-band set, and a John Mayer Trio set featuring Steve Jordan and Pino Palladino. The residency spans 21 shows from April 8 through June 12, 2027, after three June dates were added due to demand. It is Mayer’s first residency at the venue under his own name. Tickets start at $129 via Ticketmaster, with secondary options on StubHub, Vivid Seats, and SeatGeek.
 The Rooms That Close First
 Two Door Cinema Club — Tourist History Tour (clubs and theaters, May 6–29) . The Tourist History 15th anniversary tour includes a 14-date U.S. leg in May 2027, running from May 6 in Chicago to May 29 in Dallas. The band performs its debut album Tourist History in full. Friendly Fires supports on most dates of the 14-date U.S. tour, though not on every stop, including the Salt Lake City Kilby Block Party date. Venues include Chicago’s Riviera Theater on May 6, Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, CO on May 11, Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles on May 22, White Oak Music Hall in Houston on May 28, and The Bomb Factory in Dallas on May 29. The band also appears at Kilby Block Party in Salt Lake City on May 14. General sale opened October 30, 2026. These rooms will not be available on the next album cycle.
 Matchbox Twenty 30 (amphitheaters, May 15–30) . The band marks three decades since the 1996 release of its debut album, Yourself or Someone Like You , with a 52-date North American run. May U.S. dates include May 15 in Birmingham at Coca-Cola Amphitheater, May 16 in Charlotte at Truliant Amphitheater, May 18 in Nashville at Bridgestone Arena, May 20 in Kansas City at Morton Amphitheater, and May 22–23 at Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, CO. The All-American Rejects open the first four shows. The Wallflowers support on 25 shows beginning with the Red Rocks dates on May 22–23 and continuing through Virginia Beach on July 3, 2027, after which other acts take over. General sale was October 23, 2026.
 Choir! Choir! Choir! (mid-sized rooms, May 6–7) . Two Pacific Northwest dates define this short run. The first is May 6 at Tower Theatre in Bend, Oregon, a 460-seat venue, expandable to about 500, owned and operated by the nonprofit Tower Theatre Foundation. The official listing shows tickets starting at $17, ranging from $17 to $37, plus an $8 Historic Preservation fee . The second is May 7 at Mount Baker Theatre's Main Stage in Bellingham, WA, which has a house capacity of 1,509 seats and 8 permanent wheelchair spaces . Tickets there start at $49.75, including the venue’s Historic Venue Operations fee . Availability was already limited as of November 4, 2026.
 Best Music Festivals In The US In May 2027
 Six major festivals anchor the May 2027 calendar. Early May leans toward heavy rock weekends, while mid-to-late May mixes multi-genre and electronic lineups. Each festival below lists its core offering and current pricing.
 Welcome to Rockville — May 6–9, 2027, Daytona International Speedway, Daytona Beach, FL. Danny Wimmer Presents' Florida flagship drew 210,000 people and featured more than 160 bands in 2026. The 2027 full lineup was revealed on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 12:00pm EST / 9:00am PST . Four-day GA passes are listed at $470 all-in, with the next price level at $495, and 4-Day VIP passes at $890 all-in, with the next level at $920. Layaway plans start at $1 down .
 Sonic Temple Art + Music Festival — May 13–16, 2027, Historic Crew Stadium, Columbus, OH. Iron Maiden headlines Friday, May 14. Additional confirmed acts include A Perfect Circle, Meshuggah, Testament, Primus, Clutch, Bullet For My Valentine, Sleep Theory, Hanabie., and The Warning. The 2026 edition, held May 14–17 at Historic Crew Stadium, sold out and drew more than 184,000 fans, according to producers Danny Wimmer Presents . Four-day GA passes start at $450 all-in for GA Stadium, with 4-Day GA Field at $630; Friday-only GA Stadium is $195 all-in . Layaway starts from $1 down.
 Boardwalk Rock — May 14–16, 2027, Ocean City Inlet, Ocean City, MD. Korn headlines Friday, Bad Omens headlines Saturday, and Iron Maiden closes Sunday in the final show of their Run For Your Lives tour. Also on the bill are Alice in Chains, Judas Priest, The Pretty Reckless, Slash featuring Myles Kennedy and the Conspirators, Cypress Hill, and Marilyn Manson. Presale began October 22, 2026.
 Kilby Block Party — May 14–16, 2027, Utah State Fairpark, Salt Lake City, UT. Headliners include Deftones, The Strokes, Jungle, Fontaines D.C., Slayyyter, and Lil Yachty. The undercard features Two Door Cinema Club performing Tourist History in full, along with IDLES, Spoon, Weyes Blood, Hot Chip, Julien Baker, Wednesday, and Silversun Pickups. Tickets go on sale October 29, 2026.
 Sand In My Boots — May 21–23, 2027, Gulf Shores, AL. Morgan Wallen curates this beachfront festival, produced by AEG Presents. Headliners are Morgan Wallen, Kings of Leon, and Ella Langley. Three-day passes go on sale to the general public on Friday, November 6, 2026 at 10 a.m. CT, following a local-resident presale that begins November 5 at 1 p.m. CT; no single-day passes are available . GA starts at $676.87 including taxes and beach restoration fees.
 EDC Las Vegas — EDC Dusk: May 14–16 / EDC Dawn: May 21–23, 2027, Las Vegas Motor Speedway, Las Vegas, NV. The festival runs a two-weekend format at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway, whose EDC capacity is generally cited as roughly 170,000–175,000 across all stages, though some ticket resale listings state 131,000 . Three-day GA passes start at $479.99 for EDC Dusk and $529.99 for EDC Dawn, all-in before taxes and delivery fees.
 Additional Mentions
 Several smaller or more niche events round out the month beyond the six anchor festivals. Lineups and pricing can shift more often for these, so fans should confirm details before booking travel.
 Northwest Terror Fest IX — May 6–8, Seattle, WA. Napalm Death, Deadguy performing Fixation On A Coworker , and SubRosa are among the announced acts. Three-day tickets are on sale, and early-bird passes are already gone.
 Josiah Queen — Damascus Road Tour. Dickies Arena, Fort Worth, TX, May 5 and May 8, 2027, supporting his album Damascus Road .
 Maryland Deathfest XXII — May 27–30, Baltimore, MD. More than 90 bands perform across five venues and stages: Market Place, Power Plant Live!, Nevermore Hall, Soundstage, and Angels Rock Bar . Highlights include Autopsy’s 40th-anniversary set and Enslaved performing Vikingligr Veldi . Fewer than 100 four-day passes remained as of August 2026.
 Breakaway Music Festival — May 14–15 (Atlanta, GA) and May 28–29 (Columbus, OH). Venues and lineups are still to be announced. Two-day passes for the Houston 2026 edition start at $159, with other markets ranging from about $149 to $199 for two-day general admission, which offers a rough guide to likely pricing.
 Lightning in a Bottle — May 26–30, Buena Vista Aquatic Recreational Area, Bakersfield, CA. Five-day passes start from $819. Availability is limited, so check the official ticketing page for current inventory.
 Patterns, Themes, And Takeaways
 May 2027’s U.S. concert density lands heaviest in the South and West. The Texas corridor alone hosts Niall Horan in Houston and Fort Worth, Metallica in El Paso and San Antonio, and Riley Green across four Texas-adjacent markets. The Mountain West sees Horan in Denver, Salt Lake City, and Phoenix, QOTSA at Red Rocks, Matchbox Twenty at Red Rocks, Calvin Harris in Salt Lake City, and Kilby Block Party in Salt Lake City, which makes the region the most festival-stacked geography of the month.
 Festival weekends fall into two clear windows: May 6–9 and May 13–16. Welcome to Rockville and Northwest Terror Fest define the first window. Sonic Temple, Boardwalk Rock, Kilby Block Party, and EDC Dusk define the second. A fan who builds a trip around either window can anchor on a festival and fill the surrounding days with arena or club shows in the same region.
 Two very different career stages share the May calendar. Iron Maiden closes a world tour at Sonic Temple and Boardwalk Rock while Two Door Cinema Club plays clubs and theaters in the same weeks, and those small-room chances disappear once the next album cycle arrives. Choir! Choir! Choir! in Bend and Bellingham represents the most time-sensitive end of that equation, as both dates showed limited availability as of November 4, 2026, so fans should check the official venue pages before planning around them.
 The confirmed-versus-watch-list distinction shapes this guide. Every show listed here carries a named source and a confirmed date as of November 2026. Rumors and unannounced dates stay outside the scope.
 That pairing of arena and club shows is what makes OnesToWatch Live the guide to use for May 2027 planning.
 Practical Reader Guidance
 Fans can verify any date in this guide by cross-referencing the named source linked inline, such as Live Nation newsroom for Horan, Pitchfork for Metallica, TicketNews for Iron Maiden and QOTSA, or Billboard for Kilby Block Party. If a date does not appear on the artist’s official site or a primary ticketing platform, treat it as unconfirmed.
 Club and theater shows sell out faster than arenas and rarely add dates. Two Door Cinema Club’s Hollywood Palladium and White Oak Music Hall stops, along with both Choir! Choir! Choir! dates, rank as the highest-urgency purchases in this guide. Those should come before the arena shows on any buying plan.
 Fans building a May trip around one festival weekend will find the May 13–16 cluster the stronger anchor. Sonic Temple in Columbus, Boardwalk Rock in Ocean City, and Kilby Block Party in Salt Lake City all fall on the same days, so a fan can choose a region, whether Midwest, Mid-Atlantic, or Mountain West, and find a full weekend of programming without overlap. The Texas corridor, with Houston on May 1, Fort Worth on May 2, and Austin on May 14, works as a standalone run for fans based in or willing to travel to the South.
 Arena tickets for Horan, QOTSA, and Calvin Harris remain available at face value, so buyers have some breathing room there. Club tickets tell a different story, as Two Door Cinema Club already appears on secondary markets in some cities. A $25 club ticket today can become a $150 resale ticket by April 2027, which is the core argument for buying the small-room shows first.
 Frequently Asked Questions
 What concerts are at the Sphere in Las Vegas in May 2027? 
 John Mayer holds seven May 2027 dates at the Sphere in Las Vegas: May 1, 5, 7, 8, 12, 14, and 15. Each show features three formats, with a solo set, a full-band set, and a John Mayer Trio set with drummer Steve Jordan and bassist Pino Palladino. The residency runs 21 shows from April 8 through June 12, 2027, after three June dates were added due to overwhelming demand, and it is Mayer's first at the venue under his own name. Tickets start at $129 via Ticketmaster, with secondary options on StubHub, Vivid Seats, and SeatGeek. No other artist has confirmed May 2027 Sphere dates as of November 2026.
 What are the biggest stadium tours in the US in May 2027? 
 Metallica's M72 Tour is the largest stadium run of the month, with five U.S. dates: Snapdragon Stadium in San Diego on May 13, Sun Bowl Stadium in El Paso on May 18, the Alamodome in San Antonio on May 22, Razorback Stadium in Fayetteville on May 26, and Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City on May 29. The M72 World Tour ran from 2023 to 2026, and Metallica's Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere in Las Vegas, spanning 24 shows from October 1, 2026 to March 13, 2027, follows it . Outside of stadium shows, Niall Horan's Dinner Party Live On Tour includes a May 2027 stretch of nine U.S. cities from Houston on May 1 to Seattle on May 27, as part of a 26-date North American arena leg running March 17 to May 29, 2027.
